title: Ziyarat of Lady Hakima
intro: The ziyarat of Lady Hakima in the Samarra devotional collection, presented separately from Lady Narjis.
description: Read Ziyarat of Lady Hakima with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.english: Peace be upon Adam the choice of Allah.
Peace be upon Noah the prophet of Allah.
Peace be upon Abraham the friend of Allah.
Peace be upon Moses the spoken by Allah.
Peace be upon Jesus the spirit of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَيْرَ خَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s best creature.
Peace be upon you, O elite of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Abdullah
and the seal of the Prophets.
Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful
`Ali the son of Abu-Talib
and the successor of Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O Fatimah
the doyenne of the women of the worlds.
Peace be upon both of you, O grandsons of the Mercy
and two chiefs of the youth of Paradise.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيُّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O `Ali the son of al-Husayn
the chief of the worshippers, and the delight of the eye of all seers.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Ali
and the splitter of knowledge after the Prophet.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَعْفَرُ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
the veracious, dutiful, and honest.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Musa the son of Ja`far
the immaculate and ever-pure.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُوسَىٰ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O `Ali the son of Musa
the well-pleased and well-contented.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ٱلتَّقِيُّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad the son of `Ali the pious.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلِيُّ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O `Ali the son of Muhammad
the immaculate, sincere, and honest.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Hasan son of `Ali.
Peace be upon the next successor.
O Allah, send blessings upon Your light, Your lantern,
the representative of Your representative,
the successor of Your successor,
and the argument of You against Your creatures.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Allah’s Messenger.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بِنْتَ فَاطِمَةَ وَخَدِيـجَةَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta fatimata wa khadijata
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Fatimah and Khadijah.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤمِنينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of the Commander of the Faithful.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ ٱلْحَسَنِ وَٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of al-Hasan and al-Husayn.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Allah’s representative.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا اخْتَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O sister of Allah’s representative.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا عَمَّةَ وَلِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O paternal aunt of Allah’s representative.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلتَّقِيِّ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayki ya binta muhammadi bni `aliyyin alttaqiyyi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O daughter of Muhammad the son of `Ali the pious.
Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon you.
Peace be upon you.

blocks.arabic: عَرَّفَ ٱللَّهُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ فِي ٱلْجَنَّةِ
blocks.transliteration: `arrafa allahu baynana wa baynakum fi aljannati
blocks.english: May Allah introduce us to you all in Paradise,
may He include us with your group,
and may He allow us to approach the pond of Your Prophet
and serve us with water from the cup of your grandfather

blocks.arabic: مِنْ يَدِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ابِي طَالِبٍ
blocks.english: and from the hand of `Ali the son of Abu-Talib.
Allah’s blessings be upon you all.

blocks.arabic: اسْالُ ٱللَّهَ انْ يُرِيَنَا فِيكُمُ ٱلسُّرُورَ وَٱلْفَرَجَ
blocks.transliteration: as'alu allaha an yuriyana fikumu alssurura walfaraja
blocks.english: I beseech Allah to show us delight and relief through you,

blocks.arabic: وَانْ يَجْمَعَنَا وَإِِيَّاكُمْ فِي زُمْرَةِ جَدِّكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa an yajma`ana wa iyyakum fi zumrati jaddikum
blocks.english: to join us with you in the group of your grandfather
Muhammad, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household,
and never to deprive us of our recognition of you.
Verily, He is Guardian and All-powerful.
I seek nearness to Allah through (my) love for you,
repudiation of your enemies,
and submission to Allah,

blocks.arabic: رَاضِياً بِهِ غَيْرَ مُنْكِرٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ
blocks.transliteration: radiyan bihi ghayra munkirin wa la mustakbirin
blocks.english: accepting Him without denial or arrogance,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ يَقيِنِ مَا اتَىٰ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ
blocks.transliteration: wa `ala yaqini ma ata bihi muhammadun
blocks.english: being fully certain of what Muhammad has brought
and showing full satisfaction with it.
We, through this, only seek Your Face,
O my Master Allah and Your satisfaction
as well as the Next Abode.

blocks.arabic: يَا حَكِيمَةُ ٱشْفَعِي لِي فِي ٱلْجَنَّةِ
blocks.transliteration: ya hakimatu ishfa`i li fi aljannati
blocks.english: O Hakimah, (please) intercede for me to win Paradise,

blocks.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكِ عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ شَاناً مِنَ ٱلشَّانِ
blocks.transliteration: fa'inna laki `inda allahi sha'nan min alshsha'ni
blocks.english: for you enjoy an outstanding status with Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِِنِّي اسْالُكَ انْ تَخْتِمَ لِي بِٱلسَّعَادَةِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an takhtima li bilssa`adati
blocks.english: O Allah, I do beseech You to seal my life with happiness;

blocks.arabic: فَلاَ تَسْلُبْ مِنِّي مَا انَا فِيهِ
blocks.transliteration: fala taslub minni ma ana fihi
blocks.english: so, (please) do not deprive me of that which I enjoy.

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
blocks.english: There is neither might nor power except with Allah the All-high and All-great.
O Allah, (please) respond to us,
accept this from us in the name of Your generosity, almightiness,
mercy, and bestowal of wellbeing.

blocks.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ اجْمَعِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi ajma`ina
blocks.english: May Allah bless Muhammad and his entire Household

blocks.transliteration: wa sallama tasliman ya arhama alrrahimina
blocks.english: and pour down peace on them, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت حکیمہ خاتون کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
